Authentication: configure secret **names**, never literal credentials. Access-token mode reads XERO_ACCESS_TOKEN. Managed-refresh mode bootstraps once from XERO_OAUTH_BOOTSTRAP JSON containing access_token, refresh_token, expires_at; XERO_CLIENT_ID / XERO_CLIENT_SECRET hold client values. PKCE omits the secret. Rotated pairs are immediately CAS-persisted in encrypted workspace storage; a 60-second CAS lock serializes refresh. Never use the same refresh grant in different workspaces/namespaces/keys or another app. Do not inspect/export token records into logs. Crash between provider refresh and persistence needs recovery within Xero's documented refresh grace period. No tokens are returned.

Requests use fixed HTTPS Xero hosts, no redirect following, bounded 2 MB response and per-request timeout. Only explicit HTTP loopback mock origins are accepted as overrides. Read HTTP 429/5xx retries are bounded to readRetries (0..2) and Retry-After/maxRetryDelayMs; a longer wait fails with metadata in the safe error message. Network failures and accounting writes are never internally retried. Configure ONF instance retries deliberately; keep write retries disabled. Errors omit raw provider bodies to avoid credential/PII disclosure.

Full page means hasMore=true conservatively; fetch nextPage until a short/empty page. The node does not accumulate unbounded results. Keep query/order stable across pages; provider data can change while paging. Scopes: accounting.invoices.read (or matching write scope).

Inputs: tenantId, query. Outputs: result. exec/next/error are control sockets. Throwing selects an explicitly wired error control route through ONF; data outputs are absent on that path.

Authentication: configure secret **names**, never literal credentials. Access-token mode reads XERO_ACCESS_TOKEN. Managed-refresh mode bootstraps once from XERO_OAUTH_BOOTSTRAP JSON containing access_token, refresh_token, expires_at; XERO_CLIENT_ID / XERO_CLIENT_SECRET hold client values. PKCE omits the secret. Rotated pairs are immediately CAS-persisted in encrypted workspace storage; a 60-second CAS lock serializes refresh. Never use the same refresh grant in different workspaces/namespaces/keys or another app. Do not inspect/export token records into logs. Crash between provider refresh and persistence needs recovery within Xero's documented refresh grace period. No tokens are returned.

Requests use fixed HTTPS Xero hosts, no redirect following, bounded 2 MB response and per-request timeout. Only explicit HTTP loopback mock origins are accepted as overrides. Network failures and accounting writes are never internally retried. Configure ONF instance retries deliberately; keep write retries disabled. Read one payment by its immutable Xero UUID with GET /Payments/{id}. A missing/nonunique result fails. No business write.

Inputs: tenantId, id. Outputs: payment, metadata. exec/next/error are control sockets. Throwing selects an explicitly wired error control route through ONF; data outputs are absent on that path.

Authentication: configure secret **names**, never literal credentials. Access-token mode reads XERO_ACCESS_TOKEN. Managed-refresh mode bootstraps once from XERO_OAUTH_BOOTSTRAP JSON containing access_token, refresh_token, expires_at; XERO_CLIENT_ID / XERO_CLIENT_SECRET hold client values. PKCE omits the secret. Rotated pairs are immediately CAS-persisted in encrypted workspace storage; a 60-second CAS lock serializes refresh. Never use the same refresh grant in different workspaces/namespaces/keys or another app. Do not inspect/export token records into logs. Crash between provider refresh and persistence needs recovery within Xero's documented refresh grace period. No tokens are returned.

Requests use fixed HTTPS Xero hosts, no redirect following, bounded 2 MB response and per-request timeout. Only explicit HTTP loopback mock origins are accepted as overrides. Read HTTP 429/5xx retries are bounded to readRetries (0..2) and Retry-After/maxRetryDelayMs; a longer wait fails with metadata in the safe error message. Network failures and accounting writes are never internally retried. Configure ONF instance retries deliberately; keep write retries disabled. Errors omit raw provider bodies to avoid credential/PII disclosure.
